title: Korean Face Solo #40 (한국 · 아이돌 · 몽환적인 · 메이크업 뱀파이어 다크 3단계 · 강함 · 마이크로더멀 핑크 하트 · 점 눈물점+입술점)

Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean pop idol visual luminous fair porcelain complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and clear glass-skin glow, early 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, soft chestnut-brown long waves with curtain bangs. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, a small dark beauty mark just below the outer corner of her left eye like a tear mole, a second tiny beauty mark above the right corner of her upper lip, each one a clearly visible dot of real skin pigment, stark pale skin, darkly shadowed sunken eyes, a hollow contour, blood-black lips, microdermal pink heart-shaped gems pressed deep into the skin: a row of five small gems along each cheekbone and one larger gem at the center of the forehead, each gem sitting on a tiny hidden metal base implanted beneath the skin and pressing firmly down so the skin around every gem is visibly pushed in, forming a clear small dimple with a soft raised ring of flesh bulging around its edge, a small natural warm shadow in each dimple, calm healthy skin with no redness or swelling, all gems well clear of the eyes, a faraway, unfocused gaze drifting just past the camera, lips softly parted, a dreamy, ethereal expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the gems catch the light; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
